## Change and source

Link the issue or discussion comment, the affected passage, and its manuscript revision.

For a fully resolved infrastructure issue, use `Closes #number`; for a partial
change, use `Refs #number`. Textbook corrections should use `Refs #number` and a
review record. A maintainer can label the source issue `close after publication`
to close it only after the approved correction is successfully published on Pages.

## Verification

Describe the change readers will see and the checks you ran. For a tracked correction,
include the review record from the [maintainer guide](https://github.com/Maokami/pl-semantics-seminar/blob/curriculum-v1.2/docs/feedback-maintenance.ko.md).
